svg.title: 02 Persist, schedule, publish, deliver
svg.desc: Detailed execution call cards in reading order. Each card shows inputs, transformations and persistence. Dashed cards are assumed connections. Branches and alternatives are explicitly labeled. Read the linked Markdown for all field contracts and errors.
svg.text: White outline = implemented function / AWS configuration • Dashed orange = assumed adapter
Read numbered cards in order; follow the explicit branch labels. Full field and failure contracts are in 02-dispatch.md.

g.text: D1 trackedRequest(webhook, deliveryId)
SELECT comment else issue/PR content; parent subject
ADD receivedAt = new Date().toISOString()
OUT nine fields: deliveryId, receivedAt, webhook_type,
id, value, repositoryId, repositoryFullName,
issueOrPullRequestNumber, senderId
D2 DynamoService.create(tableName, request)
CHECK REQUESTS_TABLE_NAME is nonblank
SEND PutCommand Item=request
CONDITION attribute_not_exists(deliveryId)
STORE nine fields; duplicate/error stops later calls
D3 SchedulerService.scheduleTimeout(request)
CHECK bus ARN, role ARN, schedule group
ADD timeout-UUID; now + 30 minutes → second precision
SEND CreateScheduleCommand; Target.Input=JSON(request)
STORE one-time schedule; no schedule ID in DynamoDB
D4 Complete one-time schedule options
SET at(timestamp), timezone UTC, flexible window OFF
SET ActionAfterCompletion DELETE
TARGET timeout bus; role; agentic.setup / TimeoutRequested
RETURN void; no cancellation on worker completion
D5 EventBridgeService.putEvent(source, type, request)
CHECK EVENT_BUS_NAME; stringify Detail
SEND one PutEvents entry to agentic-events
CHECK FailedEntryCount / ErrorCode / missing EventId
RETURN accepted EventId is discarded by webhook
D6 Webhook response and asynchronous boundary
CALL github.delivery.accepted log → respond(202, ...)
OUT normalized webhook in HTTP body, not tracked item
AWS later destination delivery is a new invocation
FAILURE earlier effects remain after later failures
D7 ProvisionRule → ProvisionDestination
MATCH any event with source on agentic-events
ADD provider envelope; connection X-Api-Key header
POST full envelope to /provision; rate limit 10/s
DETAIL original nine-field request; no transform
D8 Later: Scheduler → TimeoutRule → destination
PUBLISH saved input to agentic-timeout-events
MATCH agentic.setup AND TimeoutRequested
POST full envelope to /timeout; rate limit 10/s
DETAIL original snapshot; no later journal fields
D9 authenticateApiKey → decodeRequestBody
CHECK configured key; header lookup case-insensitive
COMPARE buffer lengths then timingSafeEqual
DECODE base64 → UTF-8 or raw body / empty string
EXIT 500 missing key / 401 mismatch; no JSON validation
D10 Actual endpoint return / assumed continuation
REAL log provision.received or timeout.received
REAL respond 202 with acknowledgement message
ASSUMED parse envelope → await create/delete service
STORE raw body in logs; real endpoint makes no write
